text.tspan: An arrow points from a folder to one it requires.
A function that changes an object lives in that object's folder.
init.lua
setup, the CsvTable command, the statusline
autocmds.lua
the csv-table augroup and the read command over the configured extensions
the session autocommands, the claim CsvTable makes on one buffer
keymaps.lua
every key and the action it names
actions/
a registry each module beside it adds to when it loads
popup/
floats, pickers, panels and dialogs drawn over the table
buffer/
csv.Buffer: the query, the page, one csv.View per window
render, color, the gutter, the hidden cursor
view/
csv.View: the active cell, the selection, the viewport, yank
keeps nvim's visual region on the selected block
file/
csv.File: opens a spreadsheet and reads its columns and formats
query/
csv.Query: filters, sort, marks, columns, paging, the row count
reader/
builds and runs the xan commands
no other folder names xan
page/
csv.Page: the drawn table and where every cell sits
utils/
text widths, json indenting, the error notifier,
which nvim modes are visual

g.text: at call time, since buffer requires it
